name: STOMACHER PADDLE BLENDER
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-SPB-8S Stomacher Paddle Blender is a standard instrument used in food microbiology, clinical, and environmental testing labs. It is used to mechanically extract bacteria and microorganisms from solid food or clinical samples inside a sterile plastic bag. The paddles apply pressure without direct contact, completely eliminating cross-contamination risks.
features: Designed for 3 to 400ml sample volumes inside sterile bags (17x30 cm)
Color touch screen LCD controller display with 3 Segments programming
Adjustable panting speed (3 – 12 times / second) and spacing (0 – 50mm)
Stainless steel door with toughened glass load & unload window
Automatic stop and anti-pinch safety functions

specifications.Window: Load & unload window w/ toughened glass door
specifications.Target Applications: Microbiological Extraction from Food, Water, Soil, and Clinical Specimens
